## 1. Master Gateway IP Directory

| IP Address | Typical Manufacturers / ISPs | Primary Use Case | Default Web Domain / Port |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `192.168.1.1` | Netgear, ASUS, Linksys, Cisco, Ubiquiti, Verizon | Home / Office Retail Routers | routerlogin.net, router.asus.com |
| `192.168.0.1` | TP-Link, D-Link, Arris, Motorola, CenturyLink | Home / Retail Routers & Cable Gateways | tplinkwifi.net, dlinkrouter.local |
| `10.0.0.1` | Xfinity / Comcast xFi, Apple, Cisco enterprise | ISP Cable Gateways | Port 80 (HTTP) |
| `192.168.1.254` | AT&T Fiber (BGW320), BT Smart Hub, 2Wire | ISP Fiber & DSL Gateways | Port 80 (HTTP) |
| `192.168.2.1` | Belkin, SMC Networks, Edimax, Siemens | Home Retail Routers | router |
| `192.168.8.1` | Huawei 4G/5G, GL.iNet OpenWrt, Teltonika | Cellular, Mobile MiFi & Travel Routers | Port 80 / 443 |
| `192.168.10.1` | Trendnet, WAVLINK, Zyxel | Retail Routers & Standalone Range Extenders | wifi.wavlink.com |
| `192.168.11.1` | Buffalo AirStation, DD-WRT Pre-loaded | Retail Routers & Open-Source Firmware | Port 80 (HTTP) |
| `192.168.12.1` | T-Mobile 5G Home Internet (Arcadyan, Sagemcom) | Fixed Wireless 5G Gateways | T-Life App / HTTP |

| `192.168.100.1` | Huawei GPON ONT, ZTE, Arris/Motorola Modems | Optical Fiber Terminals & Standalone Modems | Port 80 (HTTP) |
| `10.0.1.1` | Apple AirPort Extreme, Time Capsule | Wireless Base Stations | Apple AirPort Utility App |
| `192.168.1.2` | Secondary Routers, Access Point Mode Fallback | Network Extenders & AP Subnets | Port 80 (HTTP) |
| `192.168.50.1` | ASUS ZenWiFi Mesh Systems | Mesh Wi-Fi Systems | router.asus.com |

| `192.168.4.1` | Amazon eero, eero Pro 6, eero Max 7 | Smart Home Mesh Systems | eero Mobile App |

## 3. How to Discover Your Router IP on Any Operating System

- **Windows 11/10**: `cmd` > `ipconfig` (check `Default Gateway`)
- **macOS (Terminal)**: `route -n get default | grep gateway`
- **iPhone / iPad**: `Settings` > `Wi-Fi` > tap `(i)` icon > read `Router`
- **Android**: `Settings` > `Network & Internet` > `Wi-Fi` > gear icon > `Gateway`
- **Linux**: `ip route show default | awk '{print $3}'`
